name: SEGC3
description: The SEGC3 (SEG China 3D) dataset is a synthetic 3D seismic survey based on a complex geological model. It includes 9 shot lines with 201 crosslines and 201 inlines each, sampled at 625 time samples. Synthetic ground-roll noise is injected to create a standard testbed for coherent noise suppression methods.

name: Synthetic Marine 2D
description: A 2D synthetic marine shot gather dataset generated via acoustic finite-difference modeling on a layered velocity model with Ricker wavelet sources. Designed for testing trace interpolation and reconstruction algorithms under controlled conditions.

name: Marmousi
description: The classic Marmousi model shot gathers contaminated with additive Gaussian noise at varying input SNR levels (-5 dB to +10 dB). Widely used as a standard benchmark for seismic denoising and random noise suppression methods.

name: Synthetic Refraction
description: Synthetic refraction shot records with exact ground-truth first-break times obtained directly from wavefront modeling. Spanning a range of input SNR from -5 dB to 20 dB to test robustness of first-arrival picking algorithms.

name: Sichuan Basin Land Survey
description: Real onshore vibroseis records from the Sichuan Basin featuring strong ground-roll and ambient cultural noise. Reference clean volumes are obtained through long-stack averaging, providing a realistic field-data testbed for denoising algorithms.

name: Synthetic Super-Resolution
description: High-resolution synthetic marine shot gathers and their 2× downsampled counterparts. Designed for benchmarking seismic super-resolution methods on recovering spatially subsampled data.
